businesses.business: Outpatient diagnostic imaging and radiology software

offering_description.value: RadNet provides outpatient diagnostic imaging to patients through its network of imaging centers. It develops and sells radiology workflow and AI-assisted image analysis software to imaging providers and health systems.

primary_products.value: Radiology workflow software; medical image management software; AI-assisted image analysis software

primary_services.value: MRI; CT; mammography; ultrasound; other outpatient imaging, including X-ray and nuclear medicine

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients receiving diagnostic or screening exams; B2B: Hospitals, health systems, independent imaging centers and radiology practices

end_markets.value: Outpatient diagnostic imaging; preventive screening; hospital and health system radiology

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Diagnostic and screening exams covered by commercial insurers and government health programs; service fees: Self-pay imaging exams and optional enhanced screening services; subscription: Cloud-based radiology workflow and imaging software; licensing or royalties: Radiology software and AI image analysis tools licensed to imaging providers
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses imaging equipment and clinical staff to provide diagnostic and screening exams to patients; asset operator: Operates outpatient centers and scanners for referred and self-referred patients; software / platform: Develops software that manages and analyzes imaging data for radiology providers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Outpatient imaging in multiple US states, with software sold in North America, Europe and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: Outpatient imaging, radiology workflow software and AI-assisted image analysis

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Outpatient imaging centers; other: Patient referrals from physicians and other clinicians; direct sales: Software sales to imaging providers and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Imaging facility licensing, Medicare imaging requirements and FDA oversight of mammography and regulated diagnostic software
